# Zanzibaba Timber — Timber, Marine Board & Plywood Supplier in Zanzibar

## About
Zanzibaba Timber is Zanzibar's leading supplier of treated pine timber, marine board, plywood, construction timber and treated poles. We serve Paje, Nungwi, Stone Town and all Zanzibar American hardwood is special order only, estimated 3–4 months from confirmation, quotation required, and excluded from cash on delivery. Other product payment and delivery terms require confirmation.

## Products
- Treated Softwood Timber
- Hardwood Timber
- Treated Wood Poles
- Marine Board
- Plywood
- Construction Plywood
- Concrete Formwork Marine Board

## Services
- Timber Supply
- Marine Board Supply
- Plywood Supply
- Treated Poles Supply
- Construction Materials Supply
- Hotel & Villa Supply
- Government Supply
- Wholesale Supply

## Locations
- Headquarters: Kwa Ndevu, Daraja Bovu, Zanzibar
- Service coverage: Zanzibar City, Stone Town, Paje, Nungwi, Kendwa, Kiwengwa, Jambiani, Matemwe, Fumba, Bububu, Chukwani, Ndevu

# Zanzibaba Timber — American hardwood
Primary catalogue: https://timber.zanzibaba.com/american-hardwood
Enquiry: https://timber.zanzibaba.com/american-hardwood/enquire
Collection: Cherry, Hickory, Wormy Red Maple, Poplar (yellow poplar/tulipwood), Basswood, Walnut, White Oak, Hard Maple, Red Oak, Ash, Birch, Red Maple.
Origin: United States. Natural solid hardwood, not engineered or artificially stained.
Availability: special order only. Estimated delivery 3–4 months from order confirmation.
Pricing: request quotation. American hardwood has no cash-on-delivery option.
Confirm botanical identity, grade, sizes, quantity, drying, moisture, sample availability, documents, delivery and payment in a written quotation.
Species guidance is not an order specification or certification. Images are representative illustrations, not actual stock.
Conversion: choose a species, request a sample/project quotation or paste BOQ line items/drawing links in the enquiry form; continue to WhatsApp and send the draft. Attach original documents there.
Project services: https://projects.zanzibaba.com/american-hardwood-interiors-zanzibar
